messages:
Lina: Quick async — proposing a tiny, opt-in change to the chat/completions schema before the Dedicated rollout. TL;DR: make `message.content` accept either a string or an array of `parts` (for granular streaming), opt-in via request header `X-Redwood-Parts: true`
Sam: Do we need to bump the contract version for that? or can it be fully additive/backwards compatible?
Devin: Additive is fine, but SDKs will need to normalize. If header present, we stream `parts` in deltas; otherwise keep current `delta.content` string behavior.
Lina: Right — goal is zero-break for existing clients. header only changes streaming envelope and root event shape slightly. Can we rely on consumers to ignore unknown fields?
Marcus: Most clients ignore unknown fields, but mobile SDKs deserialize to strict models. We should provide a transitional shim in SDK v0.9.8 that accepts both shapes.
Sam: For server: how do we handle function-calling params mid-stream if parts arrive interleaved? e.g., a `tool` payload starts in part 3 and finishes in part 8. Do we emit a func_end event or assemble on-server?
Devin: We assemble on-server until the function payload end marker is seen, then emit a single `tool_call` completed object for downstream non-streaming consumers. Streaming consumers get incremental `tool_chunk` events.
Lina: Can we get a minimal example of the streaming sequence in logs for the docs? Put in the PR description too.
Devin: Sure — sample snippet: ```
> event: delta
> data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"parts":[{"type":"text","text":"Hello "}]}}
> data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"parts":[{"type":"text","text":"world"}]}}
> data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"tool_chunk":{"name":"search","chunk":"{\"hits\":["}}}
> data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"tool_chunk":{"name":"search","chunk":"\"a\"]\}"}}}
> data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"parts":[{"type":"end","tag":"complete"}]}}
```
Marcus: That looks reasonable. For backcompat: if header absent, runtime should concatenate `parts` into `delta.content` and deliver legacy string. Confirmed?
Devin: Yup — runtime will auto-collapse on header absence. We should add a metric (counter) tracking header usage and `parts` errors.
Sam: Good call. Who owns SDK shims and release timeline? Mobile (iOS/Android) needs one-week stabilization.
Marcus: I can take mobile shims. Lina — can you coordinate API docs + changelog?
Lina: Yep. I'll draft the API section and a short migration guide (examples for both streaming and non-streaming). Will ping infra for canary routing: need to route 5% of traffic to the `X-Redwood-Parts` path next week.
qa-bot: Automated test run: streaming-shape-tests v3 -> 14/16 passed (failures: partial func reassembly, header-neg tests). Full logs at https://ci.redwood.internal/xyz/1234
Sam: Noted. Devin — can you look into the two failing tests (reassembly edgecases)? If you can't finish before EOD, push a tactical skip flag to the test harness so canary isn't blocked.
Devin: On it, will triage now. If I can't finish, I'll add a `skip-reassembly` toggle behind feature-flag in tests.
Lina: Plan for next steps: 1) PR for runtime change + metric (Devin) 2) SDK shard shims (Marcus) 3) Docs + migration guide (Lina) 4) Canary config (Infra) 5% rollout Wed 09:00 PT. I'll open a tracking issue and assign owners.
Sam: Thanks — if anyone hits roadblocks, drop quick updates here. :thumbsup:
